answers.description: Rated 4.9 on Google by over 300 patients, we have been the number one family dentist in Harrogate since 1998. Two surgeries, 0% finance on treatment over £500, open 7 days a week from 8am to 8pm, award-winning hygienists and a 10 year guarantee on crowns.

headline.text: Your family dentist, open every day of the week

hero.subhead: A family dentist in Harrogate, open every day for your dental care. Book a visit that suits your week.

about.body: Oakfield Dental Practice is a family dentist in Harrogate. We set up Oakfield to give Harrogate families a dentist they can see any day of the week. We run two surgeries and open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm.

heading.text: How a visit to Oakfield works

steps.lead: Getting dental care for your family is simple, with two surgeries open across the week.

items.title: Get In Touch
items.body: Contact our practice by phone or online to ask about an appointment that suits you.

items.title: Visit The Practice
items.body: Come along to one of our two surgeries for your check-up, treatment or hygiene visit.

items.title: Ongoing Care
items.body: We look after your dental health over time, with flexible appointments across the week.

items.title: Plan Larger Work
items.body: Ask about 0% finance on treatment over £500, to help you plan bigger dental work.

heading.text: Dental care for every member of the family

items.title: Open Every Day
items.body: We open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can book a visit when it suits you.

items.title: Flexible Payment
items.body: We offer 0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.

items.title: Trusted Hygienists
items.body: Our hygienists bring care and attention to every visit, helping you look after your smile.

services.lead: Visit one of our two surgeries in Harrogate, open every day for your family's dental care.

items.title: Family Check-Ups
items.body: Bring your whole family along for regular check-ups at either of our two surgeries.

items.title: Crown Treatment
items.body: Ask about crowns and the 10 year guarantee that comes with this treatment.

items.title: Hygiene Visits
items.body: Book a hygiene visit with our hygienists, who bring care and attention to every appointment.

heading.text: Ready to see a dentist that fits your week?

cta.body: Get in touch with Oakfield Dental Practice and book a visit at a time that suits your family.

items.question: What hours is Oakfield Dental Practice open?
items.answer: We open seven days a week, from 8am to 8pm, so you can book a visit whenever it suits your family.

items.question: How many surgeries do you have?
items.answer: We have two surgeries, giving your family more ways to book a convenient appointment.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans for larger treatment?
items.answer: Yes, we offer 0% finance on treatment over £500, making larger dental work easier to plan for.

items.question: Is there a guarantee on crowns?
items.answer: Yes, crowns come with a 10 year guarantee as part of your treatment.

items.question: Who looks after hygiene visits?
items.answer: Our hygienists bring care and attention to every hygiene visit you book with us.
